They are known to be easy to use but difficult to master. [[Enemy|Enemies]] commonly wield these Weapons in [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Faron Grasslands]]. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Soldier's Spear. * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Mipha]] amiibo As metallic Weapons, Soldier's Spears will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]], and they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. However, they are unable to be burned by a [[Fire]] or [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Soldier's Spears belong to the [[Soldier's Gear]] equipment archetype, which was used in the defense of Hyrule Castle. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_002" |Life = 35 |Power = 7
